document:7:219:0.text:
Grind the <style="highlight">dry flamefern</style> with a grinder. Make sure the powder is fine enough.
Roast the <style="highlight">garlic leaves</style> until they are slightly charred. Then, grind them into a powder and mix it with the flamefern powder.
Add the powder mixture into the <style="highlight">honey amber dew</style>. Then, heat it gently until the powder dissolves completely.
document:7:219:0.source_cn:
取<style="highlight">干燥的火鳞草</style>，使用研磨器研磨成细粉，确保粉末足够细腻。
取<style="highlight">紫蒜叶</style>，用火烤至微微焦香，随后研磨成粉末，与火鳞草粉末充分混合。
取<style="highlight">蜂琥珀的蜜汁</style>加入上述粉末低温加热直至粉末溶解至不可见。
